options.label: exclude player cards reprinted in the revised editions
options.title: Player cards from older packs that were printed again in the Revised Core Set, the Angmar Awakened / Dream-chaser / Ered Mithrin Hero and Campaign Expansions, the repackaged sagas or the four starter decks are set to 0 copies. Encounter and quest cards are never affected.
